verdict.rationale: GitHub's first-party docs describe delegating coding tasks to Copilot without leaving GitHub.com. Copilot cloud agent can research a repository, plan, fix bugs, implement features and open pull requests, and tasks can be assigned from issues, from mobile, or through an Agent mode in chat. It is built in with nothing to install, and a centralized page lets users track agent sessions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated-task quality (all evidence is vendor documentation).
